# ACDSee Photo Studio Ultimate feature inventory (parity reference for Lumen)

> **Provenance note (2026-09-27):** verbatim copy of the ACDSee Photo Studio Ultimate 2027 (build 20.0.0.4660, released 2026-09-16) inventory compiled for the Lumen parity plan, rows `AC-0001` to `AC-5182`, under its original title: ACDSee Photo Studio Ultimate 2027: exhaustive feature inventory (Lumen parity input). The ids are stable and each is placed in exactly one row of [`../lumen-parity.md`](../lumen-parity.md); the Edit-mode rows (layered pixel editing) are routed there to Imago. Do not renumber; a future ACDSee version appends new ids after AC-5182 (see [`../README.md`](../README.md)).

> **Access:** the full 867-page user guide PDF was read in full (pdftotext, 13 page ranges); guide pages 291 to 293 (Catalog Files) and 691 are mostly images, so those rows are thin, and the plug-ins support page returned 404, so plug-in formats other than GSD are not enumerated. About 45 Edit-mode special-effect descriptions and some shortcut pairings from misaligned PDF tables come from product knowledge while still citing the guide page that names them.

- Product: ACDSee Photo Studio Ultimate 2027 (product code ACUW20EN), build 20.0.0.4660, released 2026/09/16 (release notes date). This is the latest version as of 2026-09-27. It replaces Ultimate 2026 (ACUW19, September 2025).
- Inventory date: 2026-09-27
- Target: Lumen (GPL, WPF, Windows photo manager and digital darkroom). Layered pixel editing rows (Edit mode layers, adjustment layers, masks, layer effects, selections, drawing tools, special effects) are listed in full but are meant to be routed to Imago.

## Sources

1. ACDSee Photo Studio Ultimate 2027 User Guide PDF, 867 pages: https://help.acdsystems.com/en/acdsee-ultimate-20/acdseeultimate20.pdf (most rows cite `#page=N`)
2. Online help (same content as HTML): https://help.acdsystems.com/en/acdsee-ultimate-20/acdseeultimate20.htm
3. Release notes, Ultimate 2027: https://www.acdsee.com/en/support/photo-studio-ultimate/release-notes/acuw20en/
4. Product page: https://www.acdsee.com/en/products/photo-studio-ultimate/ and What's New: https://www.acdsee.com/en/photo-studio/whats-new/
5. Supported file formats: https://www.acdsee.com/en/support/file-formats/ and RAW support: https://www.acdsee.com/en/support/raw-formats/
6. Press coverage for the cloud privacy terms: https://fstoppers.com/news/acdsee-photo-studio-ultimate-2027-keeps-most-its-ai-your-own-machine-904733 and, for the 2026 adaptive presets, https://petapixel.com/2025/09/17/acdsee-photo-studio-ultimate-2026-introduces-privacy-focused-ai-powered-editing/

## Method notes

- The full 2027 user guide PDF was downloaded and converted to text with pdftotext. It was split into 13 page ranges, each read in full, and every tool, command, pane, option, slider, drop-down value, filter parameter, shortcut and format became its own row. Rows were then merged, cleaned and deduplicated, and IDs were assigned in guide order (AC-0001 onward).
- Category tags: `ai` means on-device AI (face detection and recognition, AI keywords, AI image similarity, AI masks, AI denoise, super-resolution, sky replacement, face edit). `cloud` means ACDSee 365, cloud storage, mobile sync, photo website uploads and the credit-based Generative AI tools (AI Image Generation, Generative Edit, Generative Fill, AI Remove). `automation` means batch tools, Actions, plug-ins and the Activity Manager. `print`, `format` and `video` mean what they say. Everything else is `core`.
- Rows from product knowledge rather than a cited document: the "What it does" lines for about 45 Edit mode special effects whose parameter tables are only partly described are paraphrased from product knowledge, though they still cite the guide page that names them. Some shortcut key-to-action pairings in the Shortcuts areas were inferred from misaligned PDF tables (View mode fit width, fit height, zoom and pan lock, and the O, E and R keys; Edit mode ', [ and ] and the guideline keys; Develop interface panes; the Reject tag key). Check these against the in-app Customize Keyboard Shortcuts dialog. All other rows are from the cited documents.
- Known access gaps: guide pages 291 to 293 (Catalog Files) and 691 are mostly images with no extractable text, so those rows are thin. https://www.acdsee.com/en/support/plug-ins/ returned 404, so plug-in formats other than GSD are not enumerated. There is no separate HTML per-topic crawl; the PDF was used because it covers the same content.
- Formatting: no pipes, no em or en dashes in fields, 7 columns per row, validated by script.
